content: Consultation fees at the clinic vary by specialty and reflect the level of clinical expertise required: General Practice consultations range from INR 300 to INR 500, Dermatology from INR 500 to INR 800, Pediatrics from INR 400 to INR 700, Orthopedics from INR 700 to INR 1,200, and Cardiology from INR 1,000 to INR 2,500. These figures are indicative synthetic ranges for demonstration purposes and should be verified with the clinic's official billing department before quoting to patients. Diagnostic tests, procedures, and prescribed medications are billed separately and are not included in the consultation fee. Patients with valid health insurance may be eligible for partial or full coverage depending on their policy terms; please present your insurance card at the front desk before your appointment. The clinic accepts cash, all major credit and debit cards, and select UPI payment applications.
